title: Past Perfect / Ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire
bridge: Mu igifaransa, ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire (había comido) bishirwa akayunguke kako katanzwe mu gihe kirekire. Mu icyongereza, ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire (had eaten) kifite ubwoko bwihariye, ariko harimo ibyabucanya bikomeye: uburyo bwo kwandika bwihariye (mu icyongereza ni 'had + participio'), na mu icyongereza bishirwa neza n'amashusho kugira ngo bishirize akayunguke. Kwigomeka: mu igifaransa, hashimwa neza ikintu kitanzwe mu gihe kirekire (comí) aho icyongereza kishaka ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire (had eaten) kugira ngo bishirize akayunguke. Nanone, mu igifaransa, ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire kishirwa n'amashusho y'umwimerere, mu icyongereza 'had' ni igitangaza cyose.
rule: Ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire kishirwa n'amashusho y'umwimerere 'had' (cyose) + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire kishirwa n'umwimerere w'umwanya. Bishirwa kugira ngo bishirize akayunguke katanzwe mu gihe kirekire, bishirwa 'ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire'. Mu ibyemezo: umwanya + had + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire. Mu ibyemezo by'omubeshya: had not (hadn't) + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire. Mu ibyibazo: Had + umwanya + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire. Bishirwa n'amashusho kugira ngo bishirize akayunguke kugira ngo 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after'. Ibyerekeranye: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (nkunda gusoma igisomwa cyanjye mbere yo kwiyongera). Nanone bishirwa mu kwandika ibyemezo kugira ngo bishirize akayunguke (present perfect -> past perfect). Ubwoko: mu icyongereza n'ubwoko bw'amashusho kugira ngo 'after' na 'before' bishimwa neza n'ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire, ariko ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire bishirwa neza.

concept_examples.text: She had already left when I arrived.
concept_examples.translation: Yaramaze yatanzwe mu gihe kirekire ubwo nanjye nfatiriye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi lɛft wɛn aɪ əˈraɪvd/

concept_examples.text: They had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
concept_examples.translation: Ntibari batanzwe mu gihe kirekire gusubira kwita kuri kintu kirekire mbere.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ hæd ˈnɛvər siːn sʌtʃ ə ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈsʌnsɛt bɪˈfɔːr/

concept_examples.text: By the time we got to the station, the train had already departed.
concept_examples.translation: Ubwo twasohoye ku kaminuza, igare ryatangiye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /baɪ ðə taɪm wiː gɒt tə ðə ˈsteɪʃən, ðə treɪn hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi dɪˈpɑːrtɪd/

concept_examples.text: He had studied English for years before moving to London.
concept_examples.translation: Yatanzwe mu gihe kirekire gusoma icyongereza imyaka myinshi mbere yo kwimura mu London.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː hæd ˈstʌdid ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ fɔːr jɪərz bɪˈfɔːr ˈmuːvɪŋ tə ˈlʌndən/

common_error.wrong: When I arrived, she already left.
common_error.correct: When I arrived, she had already left.
common_error.correct_alt: She had already left when I arrived.
common_error.explanation: Mu igifaransa, ni byaba neza kushimisha ikintu kitanzwe mu gihe kirekire (yaramaze yatanzwe) kugira ngo bishirize akayunguke, ariko mu icyongereza, kugira ngo bishirize akayunguke katanzwe mu gihe kirekire, wishimisha ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire (had + participio). Ibisobanuro ni ibyemezo: ikayunguke 'gutanga' byatanzwe mbere yo 'gutanga', cyashimishwa 'had left'. Kugira ngo ubyitire, wishimisha ikayunguke katanzwe mbere na ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire; ikayunguke kirekire mu gihe kirekire.

levels.label: Formation: had + past participle
levels.translation: Gusuzuma: had + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire

examples.original: I had finished my work.
examples.note: Ibyemezo: umwanya + had + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire. Ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire kishirwa n'amashusho y'umwimerere w'umwanya wose.

examples.original: She hadn't seen the movie before.
examples.translation: Ntashoboye kwita kuri kintu kirekire mbere.
examples.note: Ibyemezo by'omubeshya: had not (hadn't) + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire. Remera ubwoko bw'amashusho.

examples.original: Had you ever visited Paris?
examples.note: Ibibazo: Had + umwanya + ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire. 'Ever' bishimwa mu bibazo kugira ngo bishirize 'mbere'.

levels.label: Sequence of events: past perfect + past simple
levels.translation: Uburyo bwo kwandika: ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire + ikintu kitanzwe mu gihe kirekire

examples.original: After they had eaten, they went for a walk.
examples.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðeɪ hæd ˈiːtən, ðeɪ wɛnt fɔːr ə wɔːk/
examples.translation: Nyuma yo kuba baramye, barasohoye gutanga.
examples.note: Ikayunguke katanzwe mbere (gutanga) kishimwa mu gihe kirekire; ikayunguke kirekire (gutanga) mu gihe kirekire.

examples.original: The party had started before we arrived.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɑːrti hæd ˈstɑːrtɪd bɪˈfɔːr wiː əˈraɪvd/
examples.translation: Ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire mbere yo kwasohora.
examples.note: N'ubwoko bw'amashusho kugira ngo 'before' bishimwa ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire kugira ngo bishirize ikayunguke katanzwe mbere.

examples.original: By the time he called, I had already gone to bed.
examples.phonetic: /baɪ ðə taɪm hiː kɔːld, aɪ hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi gɒn tə bɛd/
examples.translation: Kuri mbere yo kwiyongera, ntanze gutanga mu mazi.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw'amashusho kugira ngo 'by the time' + ikintu kitanzwe mu gihe kirekire bishimwa ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire mu kindi gisomwa.

levels.label: Emphasizing with already, just, never
levels.translation: Kugira ubwoba n'amashusho kugira ngo already, just, never

examples.original: She was upset because she had just lost her keys.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wʌz ʌpˈsɛt bɪˈkɔːz ʃiː hæd dʒʌst lɔːst hɜːr kiːz/
examples.translation: Yari afite ubwoba kubera yaramaze gutanga amafunguro ye.
examples.note: 'Just' bishimwa hagati y'amashusho y'umwimerere na ikintu cyatanzwe mu gihe kirekire. Bishirwa kugira ngo 'acabar de' mu igifaransa.

examples.original: I realized I had never tried sushi before that day.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈrɪəlaɪzd aɪ hæd ˈnɛvər traɪd ˈsuːʃi bɪˈfɔːr ðæt deɪ/
examples.translation: Najye nari mba ntiyari mbazanye sushi mbere yo ku wa munsi.
examples.note: 'Never' mu byemezo by'omubeshya; bishimwa kugira ngo bishirize ikintu kitanzwe mbere.

examples.original: They had already finished the project when the boss arrived.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt wɛn ðə bɒs əˈraɪvd/
examples.translation: Baratanzwe mu gihe kirekire igisomwa nyuma yo kwasohora umukuru.
examples.note: N'ubwoko bw'amashusho kugira ngo 'already', bishiriza ikintu katanzwe mbere kirekire.

title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Ibyo bishoboka bwa 1 na 2
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, tubona ko ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca kondisionali na bwoko bw'umwimerere bw'umukandida buri mu gacaca kihanjana (Niba naba nije, njye naremeye). Mu Icyongereza, uburyo bwo kugira ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' na bwoko bw'umwimerere bw'umukandida buri mu gacaca kihanjana. Mu bwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1, tubona ko ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' na bwoko bw'umwimerere bw'umukandida buri mu gacaca kihanjana. Mu bwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2, tubona ko ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' na bwoko bw'umwimerere bw'umukandida buri mu gacaca kihanjana. Kanga ugahinda: mu Icyongereza, ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 bidahagije kuduha ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if', ahubwo bishoboka cyangwa bidahagije kuduha ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' mu gihe cy'ubushishozi cyangwa mu gihe kirekire. Ntukagire urangiza kuri ya nyandiko kureka kuri ya nyandiko, kubera ko uburyo bwo kugira ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1 na 2 bidahagije kuduha ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if'.
rule: Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1 (bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1) bushobora kugirwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi cyangwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi. Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1 bushobora kugirwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi cyangwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi: If + umuntu + igikorwa mu bwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' + umuntu + will + igikorwa kihanjana. Inyu: Niba iryanya, tuzagamburukira mu rugo. Gacaca ca 'if' cishobora kugwa mu mbere cyangwa mu magare, na igihe kigwa mu mbere, kishinzwe n'ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if'. Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 (bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2) bushobora kugirwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi cyangwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi. Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 bushobora kugirwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi cyangwa mu bihe by'ubushishozi: If + umuntu + igikorwa mu bwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' + umuntu + would + igikorwa kihanjana. Inyu: Niba naba nije, njye naremeye. Mu bwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2, igikorwa 'to be' gishobora kugirwa na 'were' kuri buri wese (Niba naba nije...). 'Was' atagombwa mu buryo bw'umwimerere, nyamara mu Icyongereza cy'umwimerere, 'was' gishobora kugirwa.

concept_examples.text: If I study, I will pass the exam.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈstʌdi aɪ wɪl pæs ðə ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: If she calls you, tell her I am busy.
concept_examples.translation: Niba yaramvuye, umubwire yuko nari wenyine.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃi kɔːlz ju tɛl hɜr aɪ æm ˈbɪzi/

concept_examples.text: If I were rich, I would buy a house.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜr rɪtʃ aɪ wʊd baɪ ə haʊs/

concept_examples.text: What would you do if you won the lottery?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd ju duː ɪf ju wʌn ðə ˈlɑːtəri/

common_error.wrong: If I would have time, I will go to the party.
common_error.correct: If I have time, I will go to the party.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had time, I would go to the party.
common_error.explanation: Mu Icyongereza, 'would' atagombwa mu gacaca ca 'if' ca byo bishoboka bwa 1 na 2. Mu ikinyarwanda, kandi tubwira 'niba naba nije', ariko mu Icyongereza, gacaca ca 'if' ca byo bishoboka bwa 1 na 2 kirimo ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' (bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1) cyangwa ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' (bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2). Kugira ngo ukeneye kugira ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if', ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1 bushobora kugirwa; niba ari byo bishoboka, ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 bushobora kugirwa.

levels.label: Type 1: Real and Possible Situations
levels.translation: Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1: ibintu by'ubushishozi na byo bishoboka

examples.original: If it rains, we will cancel the picnic.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt reɪnz wi wɪl ˈkænsəl ðə ˈpɪknɪk/
examples.note: Tubona ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' na 'will' mu gacaca kihanjana.

examples.original: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈlɛs ju ˈhʌri ju wɪl mɪs ðə bʌs/
examples.note: 'Keretse' bishobora gutegwa 'si ubu' na bidahagije kuduha ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if', cyane cyane niba ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1.

examples.original: If we don't leave now, we'll be late.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi doʊnt liːv naʊ wil bi leɪt/
examples.translation: Niba dutazajya ubu, tuzagamburukira mu rugo.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 1 bushobora kugirwa na 'we'll' kuri 'we will'.

levels.label: Type 2: Hypothetical Situations
levels.translation: Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2: ibintu byo bishoboka

examples.original: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ə kɑr aɪ wʊd draɪv tuː wɜrk/
examples.note: Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 bushobora kugirwa na 'had' mu gacaca ca 'if', nyamara bidahagije kuduha ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if'.

examples.original: If she were here, she would know what to do.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃi wɜr hɪr ʃi wʊd noʊ wʌt tuː duː/
examples.translation: Niba yari hafi, yari azaba afite ubumenyi.
examples.note: Tubona 'were' (si 'was') kuri buri wese mu buryo bw'umwimerere.

examples.original: If we won the match, we would be champions.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi wʌn ðə mætʃ wi wʊd bi ˈtʃæmpiənz/
examples.translation: Niba twaramaze, twari tubaye abakuru b'amateka.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 bushobora kugirwa na 'won' mu gacaca ca 'if', nyamara bidahagije kuduha ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if'.

levels.label: Using 'would', 'could', and 'might'
levels.translation: Kugira ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 na 'would', 'could' na 'might'

examples.original: If I were you, I would apologize.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜr ju aɪ wʊd əˈpɑləˌdʒaɪz/
examples.note: Ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if' bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere bwa 2 bushobora kugirwa na 'If I were you, ...' kugira ngo ubwoko bw'ibyabaye bw'umwimerere buri mu gacaca ca 'if'.

examples.original: If we had more time, we could visit the museum.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi hæd mɔr taɪm wi kʊd ˈvɪzɪt ðə mjuˈziːəm/
examples.translation: Niba twaba turi n'igihe, twari tubona.
examples.note: 'Could' mu gacaca kihanjana bishobora gutegwa 'bishoboka' cyangwa 'ubushishozi'.

examples.original: If they invited me, I might go to the party.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðeɪ ɪnˈvaɪtɪd mi aɪ maɪt goʊ tuː ðə ˈpɑrti/
examples.note: 'Might' bishobora gutegwa 'bishoboka' kurushaho 'would', nk'uko 'bishoboka' bishobora gutegwa.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Urutonde rw’umunyamuryango: Igihe cy’ubushake n’icy’akabya
bridge: Mu igifaransa, urutonde rw’umunyamuryango rwakorewe n’ijambo ‘ser’ + urupapuro, nk’ako mu gishanga (to be + past participle). Noneho, mu gishanga icyo kirangurirwa k’umunyamuryango kirangurirwa n’ijambo ‘by’, mu gihirandi na none turiko turishimira ‘por’. Ubwenge, mu gishanga umunyamuryango w’urutonde rw’umunyamuryango arangurirwa cyane kurusha mu gihirandi, aho hasi yihariye urutonde rw’umunyamuryango rw’umuntu (‘se’). Ikibazo gihuye ni guhagarika ijambo ‘to be’ cyangwa guhabwa n’urupapuro rw’icyo gihe cy’akabya.
rule: Urutonde rw’umunyamuryango rwakorewe n’ijambo ‘to be’ mu gihe gishushanyije (igihe cy’ubushake: am/is/are; igihe cy’akabya: was/were) + urupapuro rw’ijambo rishushanyije. Umunyamuryango w’urugero rw’umuntu ararondera kuba urupapuro rw’umunyamuryango n’ijambo ‘by’ (naho utagomba kugaragazwa niba ntirushobora). Kugira ngo ukore urutonde rw’umunyamuryango, ibintu by’urugero rw’umuntu birarondera kuba umunyamuryango. Imibare: Active: ‘The chef cooks the meal’ → Passive: ‘The meal is cooked by the chef’. Mu gihe cy’ubushake, turishimira ‘is/are’ kuringana n’umunyamuryango (umwe/abandi). Mu gihe cy’akabya, ‘was/were’. Urupapuro rw’icyo gihe cy’akabya ni urupapuro rw’ijambo rishushanyije (rutegetswe: -ed; rutagira urupapuro: urutonde). Ibikorwa: ntirishimira urutonde rw’umunyamuryango n’ijambo ziterwa (ntizirimo ibintu). Gushimisha: igihe umunyamuryango ntazwi, yihariye cyangwa arushije kurushije igikorwa.

concept_examples.text: English is spoken all over the world.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈspoʊkən ɔːl ˈoʊvər ðə wɜːrld/

concept_examples.text: The house was built in 1990.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə haʊs wɒz bɪlt ɪn naɪnˈtiːn naɪnti/

concept_examples.text: These shoes are made in Italy.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðiːz ʃuːz ɑːr meɪd ɪn ˈɪtəli/

concept_examples.text: The letters were sent yesterday.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɛtərz wɜːr sɛnt ˈjɛstərdeɪ/

common_error.correct_alt: The house was built in 1990 by the builders.
common_error.explanation: Ikibazo gishobora kugerwaho kubera mu gihirandi turishimira urupapuro cyangwa urupapuro mu buryo bwfite, ariko mu gishanga urupapuro rw’ijambo ziterwa ntirushobora kuba nk’urupapuro. ‘Build’ ni urupapuro, ‘built’ ni urupapuro rw’icyo gihe cy’akabya. Kugira ngo ugombere ikibazo, gukora urutonde rw’ijambo ziterwa no kugura urupapuro. No kugira ico gituma turishimira ijambo ‘to be’ mu rutonde rw’umunyamuryango, nk’uko: ‘The house built in 1990’ (ntiryo yegereye). None ntiwandike ko ugomba ‘was/were’ + urupapuro.

examples.original: The coffee is made with fresh beans.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔːfi ɪz ˈmeɪd wɪð frɛʃ biːnz/
examples.note: Mu gihe cy’ubushake, turishimira ‘is’ n’abantu b’umwe no ‘are’ n’abandi.

examples.original: These books are read by many students.
examples.phonetic: /ðiːz bʊks ɑːr rɛd baɪ ˈmɛni ˈstuːdənts/
examples.note: Urupapuro rw’umunyamuryango rwakorewe n’ijambo ‘by’. Mu gihirandi turishimira ‘por’.

examples.original: The window is cleaned every week.
examples.note: Mu gihirandi turishimira urutonde rw’umunyamuryango rw’umuntu ‘se’ kurushije urutonde rw’umunyamuryango n’ijambo ‘ser’.

examples.original: The movie was directed by Spielberg.
examples.note: Turishimira ‘was’ n’abantu b’umwe mu gihe cy’akabya.

examples.original: The cookies were baked by my grandmother.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʊkiz wɜːr beɪkt baɪ maɪ ˈɡrænˌmʌðər/
examples.note: ‘Were’ turishimira n’abandi.

examples.original: The letter was written in Spanish.
examples.note: Urupapuro rw’ ‘write’ ni ‘written’ (rutagira urupapuro).

examples.original: The car was stolen last night.
examples.note: Ntugomba gutanga ‘by someone’ kubera ko ntazwi cyangwa ntirushobora.

examples.original: Rice is grown in many countries.
examples.note: Urupapuro rw’umunyamuryango ni umunyamuryango, ntugomba gutanga.

examples.original: The tests are graded by the teacher.
examples.phonetic: /ðə tɛsts ɑːr ˈɡreɪdɪd baɪ ðə ˈtiːtʃər/
examples.note: Aho turimo turishimira urupapuro rw’umunyamuryango kubera ko yihariye.

title: Reported Speech / Ubutumwa bw'umwihariko
bridge: Mu gihingirishya, igihe ubishyura ku mutwe wa style indirect, ubishyura n'imizi y'imfashanyo (nk'uko 'yavuze ko yari afite indwara'), n'aha mbere bishyurwa neza kandi bifite ibindi bishyurwa: amabwiriza, amagambo yo ku wa muduhumbwe na wa kuri (today→that day, here→there) n'uburyo amagambo yashyizweho. Ikibazo gihuye ni kugabanya ubwoko bw'imfashanyo (yavuze: 'I am tired' → *She said she is tired), ariko mu gihingirishya B1, 'backshift' ni ikibazo: 'She said she was tired'. Ikindi kibi koko ni ko mu gihingirishya, 'that' ntibishyirwa mu byo byagombwa (ushobora kuvuga 'She said she was tired' cyangwa 'She said that she was tired'), kandi mu gihugu cy'Espanya, 'que' ni byagombwa.
rule: Ubutumwa bw'umwihariko bushyirwa kugena ibyavuzwe n'umwe. Mu gihingirishya, igisubizo cy'imfashanyo kiruta 'say' cyangwa 'tell'. 'Say' ntikigomba umuntu w'umwihariko (Yavuze ko yari afite indwara), kandi 'tell' kiragomba umuntu (Yavuze ko yari afite indwara). Ibishyurwa by'ingenzi: 1) Imizi y'imfashanyo (imfashanyo→imfashanyo, imfashanyo→imfashanyo): 'I am' → 'she was', 'I went' → 'she had gone'. 2) Amabwiriza: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her'. 3) Amagambo yo ku wa muduhumbwe: 'today'→'that day', 'tomorrow'→'the next day', 'yesterday'→'the day before'. 4) Ahantu: 'here'→'there'. Ibikorwa: n'iyo igikorwa kirenze gutandukanywa cyangwa igihe ntikigeze gishize, ushobora kugabanya ubwoko bw'imfashanyo (Yavuze ko yari afite indwara - n'iyo yari afite indwara). Kuri ibibazo, 'if' cyangwa 'whether' bushyirwa kuri si/no, n'ijambo ry'ibibazo kuri ibibazo by'ubwoko bw'ibintu, na muryango w'amagambo (Yavuze ko yari afite indwara, nt'ubundi 'where did I live'). Kuri amabwiriza/ibikorwa, 'tell/ask + umuntu + to + infinitivo' bushyirwa (Yavuze ko yari afite indwara).

concept_examples.text: She said that she was hungry.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː sed ðæt ʃiː wəz ˈhʌŋɡri/

concept_examples.text: He told me he would come the next day.
concept_examples.translation: Yavuze ko yari kuba azaza ku munsi wacyejwe.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː toʊld miː hiː wʊd kʌm ðə nekst deɪ/

concept_examples.text: They asked if I had seen the movie.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ æskt ɪf aɪ hæd siːn ðə ˈmuːvi/

concept_examples.text: She told me to close the door.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː toʊld miː tuː kloʊz ðə dɔːr/

common_error.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
common_error.correct: She told me that she was tired.
common_error.correct_alt: She said that she was tired.
common_error.explanation: Ikibazo kigeze kuko mu gihugu cy'Espanya, 'decir a alguien' (yavuze a mbere), ariko mu gihingirishya, 'say' ntikigomba umuntu w'umwihariko. 'Tell' ni ikigomba n'iyo ubwiye umuntu (Yavuze a mbere) cyangwa 'say' ntikigomba umuntu (Yavuze).

examples.original: I am happy.
examples.note: Mu butumwa bw'umwihariko, 'am' bishyurwa ku 'was'.

examples.original: She said she was happy.
examples.note: Reeba uburyo 'am' bishyurwa ku 'was' na 'I' ku 'she'.

examples.original: I will help you.
examples.note: 'Will' bishyurwa ku 'would' mu butumwa bw'umwihariko.

examples.original: He said he would help me.
examples.note: Ukurikirana kw'ibishyurwa bya 'will' ku 'would' na amabwiriza.

examples.original: Are you tired?
examples.note: Kuri ibibazo bya si/no, 'if' cyangwa 'whether' bushyirwa mu butumwa bw'umwihariko.

examples.original: She asked if I was tired.
examples.note: Uburyo bw'ibibazo bishyurwa ku by'amagambo: 'I was' nt'ubundi 'was I'.

examples.original: Where do you live?
examples.note: Ibibazo by'ubwoko bw'ibintu biruta ijambo ry'ibibazo mu butumwa bw'umwihariko.

examples.original: He asked me where I lived.
examples.note: Kugabanya 'do' ku 'lived' na uburyo bw'amagambo.

examples.original: Please sit down.
examples.note: Amabwiriza ashishirwa na 'tell' + umuntu + infinitivo.

examples.original: She asked me to sit down.
examples.note: 'Asked me' bushyirwa kuri ibikorwa by'ubwoba.

examples.original: Don't touch that!
examples.note: Kuri amabwiriza menshi, 'not to' bushyirwa.

examples.original: He told me not to touch that.
examples.phonetic: /hiː toʊld miː nɑːt tuː tʌtʃ ðæt/
examples.note: Uburyo: 'tell + umuntu + not to + verbo'.

title: Gerunds and Infinitives as Subject and Object / Ibyahinduwe n’ibyabaye nk’ibiri bishyura n’ibyo bisubirwa
bridge: Mu gaciri, dutegura ibyabaye (to + igisubizo) kugeza ahantu hejuru y’amatsinda menshi (ntibiboneka, ‘to swim is fun’, ‘I like to swim’). Mu Icyongereza, ibintu bifite uburyo munsi: hafi ubwo dutegura ibyahinduwe (-ing) na hafi ubwo dutegura ibyabaye (to + igisubizo). Igisubizo gishya ni ico gituma dusaba ibyabaye nk’ibiri bishyura cyangwa ibyo bisubirwa n’amatsinda menshi nk’‘enjoy’ cyangwa ‘finish’, dusaba ibyahinduwe. Kandi n’ubundi dusaba ibyabaye nk’‘want’ cyangwa ‘decide’. Ibi ni ubwokozi bw’ingenzi kuri abahanga icyongereza kubera ko nta mubiri w’ibyabaye ufite ubwokozi bw’ibyabaye.
rule: Mu Icyongereza, harimo uburyo munsi bw’ibyabaye: ibyahinduwe (gisubizo + -ing) na ibyabaye (to + urupapuro rw’igisubizo). Nk’ibiri bishyura, ibyahinduwe ni uburyo bw’ingenzi (ntibiboneka, ‘Swimming is healthy’). Nk’ibyo bisubirwa, igisubizo gishya ni ico gituma dusaba ibyabaye: amatsinda menshi ashobora kwinjirana n’ibyabaye (enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider), ubundi dusaba ibyabaye (want, need, decide, hope, plan). Amatsinda menshi ashobora guhindura ubwokozi bwabo kugeza ahantu hejuru y’uburyo bw’ibyabaye (nk’‘stop’ cyangwa ‘remember’). Kuri abashakisha B1, ni byo kuba neza kugira ubushakashatsi bw’amatsinda menshi kandi kwinjira mu mibare.

concept_examples.text: Swimming is good exercise.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈswɪmɪŋ ɪz ɡʊd ˈɛksərsaɪz/

concept_examples.text: I enjoy reading books.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈriːdɪŋ bʊks/

concept_examples.text: She wants to travel to Spain.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi wɒnts tə ˈtrævəl tə speɪn/

concept_examples.text: It is important to study every day.
concept_examples.translation: Ni byo kuba neza kugira ubushakashatsi bw’ibyifuzo byose.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪmˈpɔːrtənt tə ˈstʌdi ˈɛvri deɪ/

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri, tusaba ‘nshimagiye gutanga ifilimu’ n’ibyabaye. Ariko mu Icyongereza, igisubizo ‘enjoy’ bisaba ibyahinduwe. None abahanga icyongereza bashobora gusaba ‘to + igisubizo’ ahandi ‘-ing’. Kandi kugira ngo ubwo butandukanye, ni byo kuba neza kugira ubushakashatsi bw’amatsinda menshi. Hapa harimo urutonde: enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider, mind. Remera: iyo usabye ‘enjoy’, igisubizo gishya kirahinduka ku -ing.

examples.original: Running is fun.
examples.note: Mu Icyongereza, dusaba ibyahinduwe (-ing) nk’ibiri bishyura, si ibyabaye. ‘To run is fun’ ni byo kuba neza ariko si byo kuba neza; dusaba ibyahinduwe.

examples.original: Learning English takes time.
examples.note: Remera ko igisubizo gishya ‘takes’ gishikana mu ndimi y’umuntu w’umwe kubera ko ibyahinduwe ni umuntu w’umwe.

examples.original: Cooking is my favorite hobby.
examples.note: Ibi ni ubwokozi bw’ingenzi; remera ko ibyahinduwe bifuza umuntu w’umwe.

examples.original: I suggest going to the beach.
examples.note: Igisubizo ‘suggest’ bisaba ibyahinduwe, si ibyabaye. Ntushobora gusaba ‘suggest to go’.

examples.original: She avoids eating junk food.
examples.note: ‘Avoid’ bisaba ibyahinduwe. Nta mubiri w’ibyabaye ufite ubwokozi bw’ibyabaye.

examples.original: We finished cleaning the house.
examples.note: Kugeza ahantu hejuru y’‘finish’, dusaba ibyahinduwe. Mu gaciri ushobora gusaba ‘twatsembatsembeje kwitsa’, ariko mu Icyongereza ntushobora gusaba ‘to’.

examples.original: They hope to pass the exam.
examples.note: Igisubizo ‘hope’ bisaba ibyabaye. Winjira mu mibare n’amatsinda nk’want, need, decide.

examples.original: I need to buy some milk.
examples.note: Remera ‘need’ bisaba ibyabaye, ariko ‘enjoy’ bisaba ibyahinduwe. Ni byo kuba neza kugira ubushakashatsi bw’ibyifuzo byose.

examples.original: She decided to move to London.
examples.note: Kugeza ahantu hejuru y’‘decide’, dusaba ‘to + igisubizo’. Mena ubwokozi bw’‘to’ nk’ /tə/.

translations.rw: Ibyahinduwe n’ibyabaye nk’ibiri bishyura n’ibyo bisubirwa

title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Imirimo y’ibitanzwe n’urupapuro (must, might, could)
bridge: Mu gaciri, tubika ‘yeguye kubera’ kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ukwiye, ‘bashobora kuba’ kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha, n’ ‘bashobora kuba’ kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha bugaragaza. None n’ubundi, mu Icyongereza harimo ububabare bw’inguvu: imirimo y’ibitanzwe ntibikorwa n’ubwoko n’ubundi ntibikorwa n’ijambo ‘to’. Ikindi kintu gikwiye kubibwa ni uko mu gaciri, harakaze kubika ‘yazobona’ kugira ngo tubitanze, ariko mu Icyongereza tubika ‘must’ + umubare w’ijambo. Ibintu byakoreka ko ubishishije kubera ukubika ijambo ry’ubundi. Niba ubishishije: mu Icyongereza, ubitanzwe bukorwa n’imirimo + umubare w’ijambo, bitandukanye n’ ‘to’, n’uburyo bwo kuganira ni umuntu + imirimo + ijambo.
rule:
Mu Icyongereza, kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu by’ubushishozi tubika ‘must’, ‘might’ n’ ‘could’. 
- **Must** + umubare w’ijambo: bikwiye kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ukwiye (ubushishozi, ububiko bw’inguvu). Birenze ‘yeguye kubera’ mu gaciri. Inyuze: ‘She must be at home’ (Yeguye kubera yubamo mu rugo). 
- **Might** + umubare w’ijambo: bikwiye kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha, ubushishozi. Birenze ‘bashobora kuba’ cyangwa ‘byaba’. Inyuze: ‘He might be sick’ (Bashobora kuba yihuye). 
- **Could** + umubare w’ijambo: bikwiye kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha, ariko kandi bashobora kuba batibye. Birenze ‘bashobora kuba’. Inyuze: ‘It could rain today’ (Bashobora kuba igica iryohereza). 

**Imirimo:** imirimo ntibikorwa n’ubwoko (ntibikorwa n’ ‘-s’ n’umuntu). Ntibikorwa n’ ‘to’ nyuma yabo. Ukuvomoza ‘must’ kugira ngo tubitanze ni ‘can't’ (si ‘mustn't’): ‘She can't be at work’ (Ntashobora kuba akazi). 

**Uburyo bwo kwigisha:** bikoreshwa kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu by’ubushishozi mu bushake. Kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu by’ubushake, tubika ‘must have + umubare w’ijambo’, ‘might have + umubare w’ijambo’, cyangwa ibindi, ariko ibyo ni byinshi kuri B1. 

**Ibikorwa:** ‘must’ ntibikoreshwa mu ibibazo by’ubitanzwe; ahubwo tubika ‘Do you think...’ cyangwa uburyo bwo kubuza n’ ‘be’ cyangwa imirimo yambi.

concept_examples.text: She must be the new teacher.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː mʌst biː ðə njuː ˈtiːtʃər/

concept_examples.text: He might come to the party.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː maɪt kʌm tə ðə ˈpɑːrti/

concept_examples.text: That could be a very good idea.
concept_examples.translation: Ibyo bashobora kuba ari ibintu byiza.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðæt kʊd biː ə ˈveri ɡʊd aɪˈdiːə/

common_error.correct_alt: He has to study (if meaning obligation).
common_error.explanation: Ibikorwa bikorwa kubera ko abanyarwanda bashaka kubika ‘to’ nyuma y’imirimo, kubera mu gaciri tubika ‘yeguye kubera gusoma’ n’ ‘kubera’ bikorana n’ ‘to’. None n’ubundi, mu Icyongereza imirimo (must, might, could) bikurikiwe n’umubare w’ijambo, bitandukanye n’ ‘to’. Kugira ngo ubyitange, nibuke: imirimo + umubare w’ijambo, si imirimo + to + ijambo.

levels.label: Must for strong deduction
levels.translation: Must kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ukwiye

examples.original: The lights are off. They must be sleeping.
examples.phonetic: /ðə laɪts ɑːr ɔːf. ðeɪ mʌst biː ˈsliːpɪŋ/
examples.translation: Amashushanyo yatsinze. Yeguye kubera barimo barara.
examples.note: Tubika ‘must’ mugihe harimo ububiko bw’inguvu bukwiye kugira ngo tubitanze.

examples.original: She has a key. She must live here.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː hæz ə kiː. ʃiː mʌst lɪv hɪər/
examples.translation: Yifuze ikimenyetso. Yeguye kubera yubamo aha.
examples.note: Rebera ko nyuma y’ ‘must’ tubika umubare w’ijambo bitandukanye n’ ‘to’.

levels.label: Might for possibility
levels.translation: Might kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha

examples.original: I might go to the cinema tonight.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ maɪt ɡəʊ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə təˈnaɪt/
examples.translation: Bashobora kuba azaza mu kino k’ijoro.
examples.note: ‘Might’ bikwiye kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha, ariko ntibishobora kuba byize.

examples.original: The phone might be in your bag.
examples.phonetic: /ðə fəʊn maɪt biː ɪn jɔː bæɡ/
examples.translation: Bashobora kuba telefone yawe iri mu saco yawe.
examples.note: Mu gaciri ‘bashobora kuba’ bikurikiwe n’umubare w’ijambo, ariko mu Icyongereza tubika ‘might’ + umubare w’ijambo.

levels.label: Could for general possibility
levels.translation: Could kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha bugaragaza

examples.original: It could snow tomorrow.
examples.note: ‘Could’ bikoreshwa kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha bugaragaza, byinshi n’ibintu by’ubushishozi.

examples.original: They could be at the airport now.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ kʊd biː æt ði ˈeəpɔːt naʊ/
examples.translation: Bashobora kuba bari mu akagari ubu.
examples.note: Mu kino kigeragezo, ‘could’ n’ ‘might’ birenze, ariko ‘could’ bikwiye kugira ngo tubitanze ibintu bifite inyobwa y’ububasha bugaragaza.
